exposure: SARS-CoV-2 prevention precautions (contact and respiratory precautions, single support person, masking, staff PPE)
cohort: Women with singleton deliveries at Mount Sinai Hospital who labored during either the pandemic period (March 1-May 31, 2020) or the prepandemic period (March 1-May 31, 2019).
finding: The implementation of SARS-CoV-2 prevention precautions, including respiratory and contact measures, was not associated with a change in the risk of endometritis or intra-amniotic infection.
